title: Come, Thou Fount of Ev'ry Blessing

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: [Verse 1]
Come thou fount of every blessing
Tune my heart to sing thy grace

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Streams of mercy never ceasing
Call for songs of loudest praise
Teach me some melodious sonnet
Sung by flaming tongues above

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise the mount I'm fixed upon it
Mount of God's unchanging love

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Here I raise my Ebenezer
Hither by Thy help I've come
And I hope by thy good pleasure
Safely to arrive at home

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus sought me when a stranger
Wandering from the fold of God

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: He to rescue me from danger
Interposed His precious blood

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be
Let Thy grace now like a fetter
Bind my wandering heart to Thee

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Prone to wander, Lord I feel it
Prone to leave the God I love
Here's my heart, oh, take it seal it
Seal it for Thy courts above

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Prone to wander, Lord I feel it

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Here's my heart, oh take and seal it
Seal it for Thy courts above
